description: Design a continuous roller-coaster route, replay the rider, and bring every marked speed and force reading inside the safety envelope.

metadata.notes: Original continuous track-design bridge grounded in the supplied Roller Coaster Design and Energy Skate Park survey records. name: Loopmaker's Trial
natural_language: Tune the amber route until the rider completes every marked hill, loop, and dip without leaving the safety envelope.
